scope_statement: Validation was run against the detached origin/main candidate only. The task branch contains later local integration commits, including plan_generation files, but those commits were intentionally excluded from the candidate evidence.

blocking_findings.summary: origin/main does not expose the PlanGeneration evolution API, active generation ledger, or pm_plan_generations schema required to reproduce T1315 as an atomic T1315->T1314 generation transition.
